mapper.sql: select ss.scope_id, ss.schedule_resource_id, ss.resource_id, ss.allowed_schedule_id, ss.source_type, ss.enabled, ss.create_by, ss.create_time, ss.update_by, ss.update_time, ss.deleted, s.schedule_name as allowed_schedule_name from competition_scene_resource_schedule_scope ss left join competition_scene_schedule s on ss.allowed_schedule_id = s.schedule_id and s.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select allowed_schedule_id from competition_scene_resource_schedule_scope where schedule_resource_id = #{scheduleResourceId} and enabled = 1 and deleted = 0 order by scope_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into competition_scene_resource_schedule_scope (schedule_resource_id, resource_id, allowed_schedule_id, source_type, enabled, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted) values (#{scheduleResourceId}, #{resourceId}, #{allowedScheduleId}, #{sourceType}, #{enabled}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: update competition_scene_resource_schedule_scope set deleted = 1, enabled = 0, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where schedule_resource_id = #{scheduleResourceId} and allowed_schedule_id = #{allowedScheduleId} and source_type = 'MANUAL_BIND' and deleted = 0
